name: Camagüey

queries.query: Camagüey Cuba official cadastral parcel map GIS cadastre registry public viewer API
queries.result: Discovery found Cuba's national cadastre legal and institutional sources, including the national/municipal Planning-Physical structure and the INOTU presentation describing planned web geoservices. No first-party Camagüey parcel viewer or anonymous ID-plus-geometry API was found.

queries.query: Camagüey Cuba catastro mapa parcelario registro de la propiedad visor GIS oficial
queries.result: La búsqueda encontró evidencia institucional del Catastro Nacional, del Instituto Nacional de Ordenamiento Territorial y Urbanismo y de las direcciones municipales de Planificación Física, además de la oficina registral de Camagüey. No se verificó un visor parcelario público ni una respuesta anónima con identificador nativo y geometría.

registryEvidence.custodian: Dirección Municipal de Planificación Física de Camagüey, under Cuba's Instituto Nacional de Ordenamiento Territorial y Urbanismo (INOTU); Registro de la Propiedad office in Camagüey is a related property-record custodian.
registryEvidence.basis: Cuba's Decreto-Ley 332 assigns national cadastre organization/control to the Instituto de Planificación Física, decentralizes execution to provincial and municipal Planning-Physical directorates, requires municipal directorates to register municipal immovables and issue cadastral certifications, and creates/maintains urban cadastre. The 2024 INOTU presentation identifies the current national cadastre program and planned web geoservices. A 2021 property-registry source lists Camagüey as a registry office and describes the cadastral system as consulted by property registrars.

officialSources.observation: Presentation by the Director of Catastro, INOTU, describing Cuba's cadastre development, urban-cadastre rollout, official information base, and planned web geoservices; it does not expose an anonymous parcel endpoint or downloadable Camagüey parcel features.
officialSources.scope: National Cuban cadastre program; local Camagüey coverage not individually verified.

officialSources.observation: Cuban Decreto-Ley 332: municipal Planning-Physical directorates register immovables, assign cadastral references, issue cadastral certifications, and maintain urban cadastre; GEOCUBA is principal cartographic/cadastral data and technology provider.
officialSources.scope: National legal framework applying to municipal Camagüey administration; not a parcel dataset.

officialSources.observation: Secondary reproduction of Cuban property-registry rules listing Camagüey's registry office and describing registry use of the cadastral information system; not a public geometry service.

requests.outcome: Fetched and inspected 12-page INOTU presentation. It states the national cadastre includes official geospatial information and that web geoservices were planned, but returned no parcel schema, CRS, endpoint, or safe ID-plus-geometry response.
Fetched and inspected the Cuban Decreto-Ley 332 text. It documents custody and duties only; no public query route or parcel feature response was exposed.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Cuba national cadastre with municipal execution; Camagüey municipal and property-registry custody is evidenced.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous public parcel geometry, native parcel identifier, schema, or CRS was verified for Camagüey.

remainingUncertainty: The responsible Cuban municipal/national cadastral institutions are evidenced, but current Camagüey web availability, public geometry access, citywide coverage, update cadence, native ID field, CRS, and adapter robustness remain unverified. Exact-point absence, map extent, timeouts, access denial, and TLS failure were not treated as citywide absence. No credentials, private tokens, owner/address data, or unsafe fields were requested.
